en.name: Gentle standing twists
en.subtitle: Teacher-marked movement · Primary 1–3
steps: Stand with your feet comfortably apart, knees soft and arms relaxed.
Turn your upper body a little to one side and let your arms follow naturally. Do not fling them.
Turn a little to the other side without forcing the waist or keeping the feet rigid.
Return to the middle and relax. Follow your teacher’s range and pace.
en.focus: Teacher marks each turn and return; rotation depth is not automatically scored.

zh-Hant.name: 站姿輕柔扭轉
zh-Hant.subtitle: 老師記錄動作 · 小一至小三
steps: 雙腳舒適分開，膝蓋放鬆，雙臂自然垂下。
上半身輕輕轉向一邊，讓手臂自然跟隨，不要用力甩動。
輕輕轉向另一邊，不要勉強扭腰或把雙腳僵硬地鎖住。
回到中間並放鬆，轉動幅度及速度跟隨老師。
zh-Hant.focus: 老師把每次轉動及返回中間記作一次，不會自動評估扭轉深度。
